summary.text: Rita C. Joseph was elected in 2021 to represent the 40th District on the New York City Council, which includes parts of Flatbush, Prospect Lefferts Gardens, Kensington and Windsor Terrace in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography describes her as a former public school teacher and says she chairs the Higher Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her Council biography, Joseph is a union member and community organizer who at age 19 led a 150,000-person rally challenging the FDA rule restricting blood donation by Haitians.
She was a teen mother who earned a full college scholarship, and she has over two decades of classroom experience.

She co-chairs the Brooklyn Delegation and the Women's Caucus, is Second Vice Chair of the Black, Latino and Asian Caucus, and sits on committees including Immigration, Education and Housing and Buildings.
